Reading the EcdhSharedSecret off the token violates the non-extractable-by-default posture. Keep the secret on the token instead: Pkcs11Workspace.DeriveSharedSecretEcdh applies the KDF on the token and returns a sensitive key. If the export is needed, allow this one kind with ToBuilder(...).AllowSecretExport(SecretExportKind.EcdhSharedSecret, reason) on the Derived policy.

Reading the KdfOutput off the token violates the non-extractable-by-default posture. If the export is needed, allow this one kind with ToBuilder(...).AllowSecretExport(SecretExportKind.KdfOutput, reason) on the Derived policy.

Creating a key with CKA_SENSITIVE=false would create a non-sensitive key whose value can be read off the token. Leave CKA_SENSITIVE true to keep the key on the token; to read a derived or shared secret back, use Pkcs11Key.DeriveAndExportSecret / EncapsulateAndExportSecret / DecapsulateAndExportSecret or Pkcs11Workspace.DeriveAndExportSecret, which the policy decides as a narrow secret export.
